notes: Rebuilt the normal download flow: choose a release, NyaaDebrid handles AllDebrid automatically, waits for readiness, resolves files, then asks only for the final series name before queueing.
Removed the manual Send to AllDebrid / Download ready steps from the normal Search workflow.
Added one naming approval for multi-release and multi-season selections, with a live Plex-style filename preview.
Existing same-size files are skipped automatically; different-size targets are replaced only after the new download finishes successfully.
Preparation jobs now survive new searches and can resume after an app restart without being mistaken for ordinary queued downloads.
The global queue now persists explicit queue rank across restart, including drag reorder, and adds Download next / Move to top priority controls.
Added automatic refresh of expired AllDebrid direct links before a download is marked failed; the native downloader keeps its own transient HTTP retry handling.
Added a configurable free-space reserve (20 GB by default) so large downloads do not consume the last free space on a drive.
Added a short Nyaa search cache plus one-click fallback searches for no-group, all-audio, 720p, and alternate titles.
Added a Smart Profile rules preview and a per-series preferences manager.
Added richer notification actions: Retry failed downloads directly and Open folder after completion.
Added live tray status with active count, queue size, and current transfer speed.
Added quiet startup health checks, a first-run setup screen, and update-startup verification with rollback recovery if a newly installed build fails to start cleanly.
Added schema migration tracking, UI smoke tests, and stricter release gating so public releases are built only after successful CI.
Added exact local search snapshots for the future Web Remote so a web selection can download the precise release that was shown, without re-searching or re-scoring it.
Added a closed remote command contract with no shell, arbitrary file access, or generic command execution.
Added device identity and short-lived pairing groundwork for future QR / six-digit-code pairing; remote device secrets stay in Windows Credential Manager.

Remote-safe result payloads include the same recommendation score, recommendation flag, release metadata and naming source as the desktop app while keeping magnets, direct links, AllDebrid keys and Groq keys local.
Added local remote-session/job database tables as groundwork for the future multi-user Web Remote.
